title: Cyclic Latin Eulerian Numbers
summary: We introduce the directed cyclic difference inventory $D_n(\mathbf{m})$ to study Latin Eulerian numbers restricted to row-reorderings of the cyclic Latin square, offering an orientation-sensitive refinement of the prescribed-edge-length Hamiltonian path problem. We establish exact enumeration formulas, symmetries, and realizability obstructions for this inventory.
